auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID)
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN GasStationLocation AS T2
  ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND T1.Time >= '08:00:00'
  AND T1.Time < '09:00:00'
  AND T2.Country = 'CZE'
